headline:
Rates just hit
a one year high.
[[The Fed didn't do it.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Blame the bond market, not the Fed.
sources: Freddie Mac data via AP, Aug 6 2026

stats.label: The 30 year fixed just hit its highest mark in over a year, the fifth straight weekly increase.
The 10 year Treasury yield that prices mortgages sat at just 3.97% before war driven inflation fears pushed it higher.
The 15 year fixed actually eased this week, a sign this is a bond market story, not a broad rate hike.
